source.analyses: experiments/synthetic_trainers: stability_analysis.collapse_neighborhoods, and the largest_post_confirmation_gradients of stability_analysis.summarize
source.fields: Each archived case keeps the held-out accuracy of every canonical observation (a column), the observations the analyses read whole (`failures`, `probes`) and the diagnostics rows they read, without their sampler cursors, pre-clip gradient norm, moment scope and log temperatures; the reduction changes no output. `isolated` is read without diagnostics and `unsupported` is derived from `grokking`, as their sources say.

unsupported.source: grokking without the probe at update 44751, after its first failure
